blockingFindings.description: Direct V24 inspection of all five views and six poses shows the extended front apron still breaks across the seated lap: both fitted shorts and substantial upper-thigh areas remain visible in sit, and the crouch lap panels lift off the bent thighs. The V24 forwardHemThighWeight increase from 0.18 to 0.72 did not improve measured upper-thigh overskirt coverage: sit is 35.9% left / 35.5% right (V23: 37.6% / 36.8%), and crouch is 47.0% / 45.9%. Do not infer fit acceptance from this ray-coverage diagnostic.
V24 front, side, and rear renders retain irregular planar corrugation, pinched folds, and lumpy side/rear mass instead of deliberate continuous pleats.
Direct V24 back view still does not make the waist adjustment tab or buckle identifiable against the jacket and skirt.
The V24 source-bound mesh showcase records authored UV status MISSING. The topology SVG is not a UV layout.
